question: In the FY2018 Performance Rights Plan, which year has a higher number of outstanding shares at the end of the period?
retrieval_query: FY2018 Performance Rights Plan outstanding shares year comparison
answer:
The FY2019 Performance Rights Plan has a higher number of outstanding shares at the end of the period (547,949) compared to FY2018 (407,262).

Source: dc105a860fbe0bfd73a477bda3945171.pdf p.1

Calculation: 547,949 - 407,262 = 140,687 (difference)

Answer: FY2019
